sourceAuthority.name: CompTIA Cloud+ CV0-004 Exam Objectives
sourceAuthority.localVersion: Exam Objectives Document Version 5.0; CV0-004 V4; dated September 2025
sourceAuthority.versionResolution: The local CompTIA-branded Version 5.0 document is the newer curriculum authority. The official CompTIA CDN Version 2.0 document independently confirms the same 33 objectives and six domain weights; no scope conflict was found.
sourceAuthority.examComposition: Maximum 90 questions; multiple-choice and performance-based; 90 minutes; passing score 750
sourceAuthority.scopeRule: Published example lists are non-exhaustive. Curriculum judgments use the objective statements and the complete official scope rather than treating example lists as closed vocabularies.

inventory.pbqOrLabStatus: PASS — seven production missions provide 64 independently scored points across all 15 identified CV0-004 application objectives through the shared Hydra PBQ Arena.

protectedSweepIntegrity.algorithm: Sort protected banks by world then natural filename; for each file hash raw bytes with SHA-256 and append <repository-relative-path>\t<question-count>\t<file-sha256>\n; hash the complete UTF-8 manifest with SHA-256.
